# makise-kurisu-tts

> Code for an unofficial, fan-made Makise Kurisu (牧瀬紅莉栖, STEINS;GATE) text-to-speech voice, a Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base full fine-tune that speaks Japanese, Mandarin Chinese and English with no reference audio. The repository covers the dataset build, the fixed trainer, the evaluation and the research notes. Unofficial fan project; no rights to the voice are granted.

**Key facts:**
- **Voices:** `kurisu` (default), `amadeus` (the Amadeus device voice from STEINS;GATE 0) and `phone`.
- **Usage:**
  - `Qwen3TTSModel.from_pretrained("starrydark/Makise_Kurisu_Qwen3_TTS").generate_custom_voice(text=..., speaker="kurisu", language="Japanese")`
  - Install with `pip install qwen-tts`.
  - Pass the language of the text.
- **v3 against v2:**
  - Japanese CER 0.030 (v2 0.032).
  - Mandarin shared-character syllable error 0.060 (v2 0.170).
  - Blind Mandarin nativeness rating 5.0/5 (v2 3.9).
- **How the Japanese accent in Mandarin was removed:**
  - Qwen language ids;
  - about 15% native Mandarin/English replay from other speakers;
  - about 5% Kurisu-voiced Mandarin generated by the Base model.
- **Experimental tags:** `[sigh]` and `[nv]`.
- **Compute:** the shipped run took 6 min 37 s on one H100; the whole project used about 10.5 GPU-hours.
- **Upstream script bugs:** the official Qwen3-TTS fine-tuning script has four silent bugs, all fixed in `train/train_sft.py` and `legacy/v1_local/ft02_sft.py`:
  - labels shifted twice;
  - the sub-talker reads the frame it predicts;
  - `text_projection` skipped;
  - the speaker encoder decays under AdamW.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/starryark/makise-kurisu-tts/blob/main/README.md): overview, quick start, recipe, FAQ
- [Training run order](https://github.com/starryark/makise-kurisu-tts/blob/main/train/README.md): every script of the v3 run and the exact commands
- [Selection rule](https://github.com/starryark/makise-kurisu-tts/blob/main/eval/SELECTION_RULE.md): pre-registered gates and disclosed amendments
- [Cross-lingual accent report](https://github.com/starryark/makise-kurisu-tts/blob/main/research/crosslingual_accent_2026-10.md): why a Japanese fine-tune accents Mandarin and what fixes it
- [Qwen3-TTS fine-tuning fixes](https://github.com/starryark/tricolour-tts/blob/main/docs/qwen3-tts-finetuning-fixes.md): the four upstream bugs, with code and issue links
- [Dataset build](https://github.com/starryark/makise-kurisu-tts/blob/main/dataset/README.md): six-language Kurisu corpus, earned expressive tags, leakage-safe splits

## Release

- [Model](https://huggingface.co/starrydark/Makise_Kurisu_Qwen3_TTS)
- [Demo Space](https://huggingface.co/spaces/starrydark/Kurisu_Qwen3_TTS)
- [Dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/starrydark/Makise_Kurisu_Voice): 13,999 lines, 17.1 h, six languages (Japanese 10,039 clips)
- [Collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/starrydark/makise-kurisu-ai-voice-steins-gate)
